title: FUTASAKU - Quick PvP strategy duel inspired by Rummy, Chess and Go
author: ptrkptrkptrk
selftext:
This is my first (almost) finished project built primarily with AI tools I've been low-key obsessed with the last few months.

FUTASAKU is a 3-5 min competitive duel where you use cards and simple combinations to expand your territory and cut off your opponent. There's also a persistent world where you can claim land and challenge other players and stuff

I've used GPT for most of the artwork, Cursor with DeepSeek for longer testing sessions and simulations, and Claude for the foundation, new features and some design work.

If people pick up on it, I'd love to add sound, clans, more game modes and iOS/Android wrappers.

Just launched the open beta, free to play on mobile and desktop: [https://www.futasaku.com](https://www.futasaku.com/)

Curious to see what you guys think!
